# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Cleric level 10 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-8 prepared divine
# spell-bearing baseline to level 10 as chosen input only. It names selections;
# it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the
# accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the
# deterministic ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-8
# fixtures, and the same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding
# only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-9, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-11+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-10 "Special" column is blank (verified
# independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com), and 6th-level
# cleric spells first appear at 11th (the level-10 spells-per-day row is
# "4/4+1/4+1/3+1/3+1/2+1", its 6th-level column still "—"), so the domain
# spell slot count stays 5 and Channel Energy stays 5d6; the only genuine
# rise at level 10 among the domain-power facets is Touch of Good's
# half-cleric-level bonus (10/2 = 5), so no new pillar is grounded at level
# 10 — only the existing pillars are widened.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:10
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
